name: The Caldwell County Courthouse
description: The 1894 Second Empire courthouse in Lockhart, Texas, as a 46 cm LEGO display model on a 30 cm lawn: buff stone walls with red trim, four corner pavilions under slate mansards with iron cresting, a columned portico and a central clock tower whose four clocks really keep time (quartz clock inserts behind the red dials). The dome lifts off to set them.

price.note: A rough range from typical BrickLink prices per part type, not live market data.

hardware.name: Mini quartz clock insert, 1-3/8" (35 mm) fit-up
hardware.description: Press-in quartz clock movement with its own dial, hands and button cell, made for a 35 mm (1-3/8") hole: 35 mm body, a bezel of about 36-38 mm, 15-20 mm deep including the setting knob. White dial, black numerals.
hardware.where: Clock-making and woodworking suppliers (Klockit, Rockler, Woodcraft), craft stores, Amazon or eBay: search for "1-3/8 inch mini clock insert" or "35 mm clock insert".
